title: Space packet protocol header
body: All CCSDS Space Packets shall carry a 6-octet primary header: 3-bit packet version, 1-bit packet type (TM=0/TC=1), 1-bit secondary-header flag, 11-bit APID, 2-bit sequence flags, 14-bit sequence count, 16-bit data-length. Packets violating this shall be rejected by the receiving stack.

title: TC space data link COP-1 procedures
body: Telecommand transfer frames using FARM-1 shall maintain VR (receiver) state. On VC reset, both sender and receiver re-synchronise via SET V(R) directive. Frame mismatches > FARM_B count drop into LOCKOUT — escape requires UNLOCK directive from authorised source.
citation: CCSDS 232.0-B-3 TC Space Data Link Protocol §6

title: AOS Space Data Link rate-buffered insertion
body: AOS frames carrying Service M_PDU shall buffer asynchronously-arrived packets without rate-blocking the carrier. Idle insertion is via OID (only-idle data) frames per §3.2.4; OID frames must not consume more than 30 % of the link budget under nominal traffic.
citation: CCSDS 732.0-B-4 AOS Space Data Link Protocol §3.2

title: CCSDS cryptographic algorithm selection
body: Cryptographic algorithms used for spacecraft command authentication shall come from the CCSDS approved list: AES-256-GCM for confidentiality + integrity, HMAC-SHA-256 for authentication-only, RSA-3072 / ECDSA-P256 for key agreement. Older algorithms (DES, MD5, SHA-1) are forbidden.
